name: AK18D - Pocket Formaldehyde & TVOC Detector (HCHO, TVOC), 39g Air Quality Tester
highlights: The Renovation Pair, Pocket Sized — Formaldehyde and TVOC come from the same sources — board, adhesive, paint, upholstery — and both need watching for months after a fit-out.
Small Enough for a Buyer to Take Viewing — 39 g in a jacket pocket. A reading taken during a viewing carries more weight than a reading taken after moving in.
Two Channels, Two Colour Bands — No index to interpret; each value carries its own status.
500 mAh, USB-C — About an hour to full charge.
100 Per Carton — 433 × 348 × 222 mm outer, 11 kg gross.
